{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: Upstream compatibility

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      smoke:
        type: boolean
        default: false
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      smoke:
        description: Check the locked baseline with mainline smoke
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  upstream-master:
    name: ${{ inputs.smoke && 'mainline-smoke' || 'upstream-master' }}
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule' || github.repository == 'apache/hugegraph-toolchain'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Fetch code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Java environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-java-env
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: temurin

      - name: Cache Maven dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

      - name: Resolve latest ASF master once
        if: ${{ !inputs.smoke }}
        id: upstream
        uses: ./.github/actions/get-hugegraph-commit
        with:
          repository: apache/hugegraph
          ref: master

      - name: Install SDK from the resolved commit
        if: ${{ !inputs.smoke }}
        id: sdk
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-candidate-sdk
        with:
          repository: apache/hugegraph
          ref: ${{ steps.upstream.outputs.commit_id }}
          expected-commit: ${{ steps.upstream.outputs.commit_id }}

      - name: Install locked current SDK
        if: inputs.smoke
        id: locked-sdk
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-candidate-sdk

      - name: Compile core consumers
        run: |
          mvn install -pl hugegraph-client,hugegraph-loader,hugegraph-tools,hugegraph-spark-connector -am -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -ntp
          mvn compile -pl hugegraph-hubble/hubble-be -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -ntp

      - name: Start the same-source Server fixture
        env:
          CANDIDATE_ARCHIVE: ${{ steps.sdk.outputs.archive || steps.locked-sdk.outputs.archive }}
        run: bash hugegraph-client/assembly/travis/start-hugegraph-servers.sh "$CANDIDATE_ARCHIVE"

      - name: Client unit and HTTP compatibility tests
        if: ${{ !inputs.smoke }}
        working-directory: hugegraph-client
        run: |
          mvn test -Dtest=UnitTestSuite -ntp
          mvn test -Dtest=ApiTestSuite -ntp
          mvn test -Dtest=FuncTestSuite -ntp

      - name: Client schema and graph read/write smoke
        if: inputs.smoke
        working-directory: hugegraph-client
        run: mvn test -Dtest=UnitTestSuite,GraphManagerTest -ntp

      - name: Loader and Hubble backend unit tests
        run: |
          mvn test -P unit -pl hugegraph-loader -ntp
          mvn test -P unit-test -pl hugegraph-hubble/hubble-be -ntp

      - name: Loader local-file read/write smoke
        if: inputs.smoke
        run: mvn test -P file -Dtest=FileLoadTest#testCustomizedSchema -pl hugegraph-loader -ntp

      - name: Tools functional compatibility tests
        if: ${{ !inputs.smoke }}
        run: mvn test -Dtest=FuncTestSuite -Dtools.test.disposable=true -pl hugegraph-tools -ntp

      - name: Tools public CLI smoke
        if: inputs.smoke
        run: mvn test -Dtest=CommandTest -pl hugegraph-tools -ntp

      - name: Prepare Go
        if: inputs.smoke
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.x'
          cache-dependency-path: hugegraph-client-go/go.sum

      - name: Go version and schema smoke
        if: inputs.smoke
        working-directory: hugegraph-client-go
        run: go test ./... -count=1 -timeout 30s -run '^(TestVersionRequest_Do|TestSchemaRequest_Do)$'

      - name: Stop this job's Server fixtures
        if: always()
        run: |
          for stop in "$RUNNER_TEMP"/hugegraph-servers.*/*/bin/stop-hugegraph.sh; do
            if [[ -f "$stop" ]]; then
              bash "$stop"
            fi
          done

      - name: Retain test reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: upstream-compatibility-reports-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            **/target/surefire-reports/**
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hugegraph-servers.*/**/logs/*.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7", "rationale": "The workflow runs multiple Maven invocations (install, compile, test across several modules) that repeatedly fetch dependencies on every run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) supports caching dependency downloads to save CI time, with preconditions met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs can include lockfiles (pom.xml files). The experiment batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 measured a 6.06% elapsed reduction from adding actions/cache for dependency modules. Adding a Maven local repository cache (~/.m2/repository) keyed on pom.xml files preserves all build and test steps, requires no new permissions or network access, and is a minimal workflow-only change.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}

name: Upstream compatibility

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      smoke:
        type: boolean
        default: false
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      smoke:
        description: Check the locked baseline with mainline smoke
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  upstream-master:
    name: ${{ inputs.smoke && 'mainline-smoke' || 'upstream-master' }}
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule' || github.repository == 'apache/hugegraph-toolchain'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Fetch code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Java environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-java-env
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: temurin

      - name: Cache Maven dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

      - name: Resolve latest ASF master once
        if: ${{ !inputs.smoke }}
        id: upstream
        uses: ./.github/actions/get-hugegraph-commit
        with:
          repository: apache/hugegraph
          ref: master

      - name: Install SDK from the resolved commit
        if: ${{ !inputs.smoke }}
        id: sdk
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-candidate-sdk
        with:
          repository: apache/hugegraph
          ref: ${{ steps.upstream.outputs.commit_id }}
          expected-commit: ${{ steps.upstream.outputs.commit_id }}

      - name: Install locked current SDK
        if: inputs.smoke
        id: locked-sdk
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-candidate-sdk

      - name: Compile core consumers
        run: |
          mvn install -pl hugegraph-client,hugegraph-loader,hugegraph-tools,hugegraph-spark-connector -am -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -ntp
          mvn compile -pl hugegraph-hubble/hubble-be -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -ntp

      - name: Start the same-source Server fixture
        env:
          CANDIDATE_ARCHIVE: ${{ steps.sdk.outputs.archive || steps.locked-sdk.outputs.archive }}
        run: bash hugegraph-client/assembly/travis/start-hugegraph-servers.sh "$CANDIDATE_ARCHIVE"

      - name: Client unit and HTTP compatibility tests
        if: ${{ !inputs.smoke }}
        working-directory: hugegraph-client
        run: |
          mvn test -Dtest=UnitTestSuite -ntp
          mvn test -Dtest=ApiTestSuite -ntp
          mvn test -Dtest=FuncTestSuite -ntp

      - name: Client schema and graph read/write smoke
        if: inputs.smoke
        working-directory: hugegraph-client
        run: mvn test -Dtest=UnitTestSuite,GraphManagerTest -ntp

      - name: Loader and Hubble backend unit tests
        run: |
          mvn test -P unit -pl hugegraph-loader -ntp
          mvn test -P unit-test -pl hugegraph-hubble/hubble-be -ntp

      - name: Loader local-file read/write smoke
        if: inputs.smoke
        run: mvn test -P file -Dtest=FileLoadTest#testCustomizedSchema -pl hugegraph-loader -ntp

      - name: Tools functional compatibility tests
        if: ${{ !inputs.smoke }}
        run: mvn test -Dtest=FuncTestSuite -Dtools.test.disposable=true -pl hugegraph-tools -ntp

      - name: Tools public CLI smoke
        if: inputs.smoke
        run: mvn test -Dtest=CommandTest -pl hugegraph-tools -ntp

      - name: Prepare Go
        if: inputs.smoke
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.x'
          cache-dependency-path: hugegraph-client-go/go.sum

      - name: Go version and schema smoke
        if: inputs.smoke
        working-directory: hugegraph-client-go
        run: go test ./... -count=1 -timeout 30s -run '^(TestVersionRequest_Do|TestSchemaRequest_Do)$'

      - name: Stop this job's Server fixtures
        if: always()
        run: |
          for stop in "$RUNNER_TEMP"/hugegraph-servers.*/*/bin/stop-hugegraph.sh; do
            if [[ -f "$stop" ]]; then
              bash "$stop"
            fi
          done

      - name: Retain test reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: upstream-compatibility-reports-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            **/target/surefire-reports/**
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hugegraph-servers.*/**/logs/*.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
